snippet.title: Official Teaser | Prison Breaker
snippet.description:
#prisonbreaker #casual #action #puzzle #neon #geometry #gameplay #teaser #official

As a Prison Breaker, you are a polygon trapped in the prison and destined to smash your way out. Find the right time to attack the prison. Memorize and dodge the dangerous obstacles. Watch how the prison's defense patterns evolve as you progress.

• Free Trial: https://kocowgames.itch.io/prisonbreaker
• Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4295830/Prison_Breaker
• Android: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.KocowGames.PrisonBreaker
